The decisive mistake was ArtHistory_Expert's claim at Step 5 that it had "reviewed the source", even though no page was ever fetched. No tool call or code opened the Met page for the "Twelve animals of the Chinese zodiac" artwork. That page was the key source, and it should have been examined for which animals show a hand. Because of the false claim, the team dropped the one real lead and moved to image analysis with made-up placeholder file paths. They never reached the correct answer of 11.
